pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit irregular, jagged edges with sharp pixel-level gradients. The spatial area of these regions decreases from the upper neck towards the lower flank, where they become more fragmented and polygonal.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored pathways form a continuous negative-space graph with multi-edge junction nodes. Pixel thickness of these pathways is non-uniform, showing greater width at the neck-shoulder transition and reduced width on the lower flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The 1D silhouette of the mane exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated contour against the background along the upper neck and shoulder.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple avian figures (oxpeckers) are perched on the dorsal ridge, creating localized interruptions in the 1D silhouette profile.
